name: TLL Runtime Truth
description: Canonical runtime truth for TLL OS. Defines runtime capabilities, invariants, and verified performance characteristics.

runtime_components.description: Stack-based virtual machine that executes TLL bytecode.
IO-aware cooperative scheduler managing coroutine lifecycle, yield/resume, sleep/wakeup.
runtime_components.stress_test: 100K immediate-return coroutines + 10K x 10 yield + 1K sleep, all pass on Ubuntu/Windows/macOS

runtime_components.description: Timer system for sleep and scheduled callbacks.
TCP socket implementation with non-blocking IO and select().
runtime_components.known_limitation: FD_SETSIZE=64, maximum 64 concurrent file descriptors. Exceeding 64 results in silent ignore (no crash, no buffer overflow). This was verified and fixed in P0-15.18.2.

runtime_components.description: Event reactor for IO readiness notification.
Value allocation and reference counting for strings, arrays, maps, objects, coroutines.
runtime_components.note: Source code audit found no obvious leaks. Runtime leak detection (valgrind/ASAN) has not been performed. Long-run test (120s, 4 nodes, 20 blocks) showed stable RSS but no precise leak measurement.
runtime_components.planned_verification: Future phase will add ASAN build and valgrind leak detection.

runtime_components.description: Tagged value system supporting int, float, string, bool, null, array, map, object, function, coroutine.

runtime_invariants.invariant: Coroutine created == coroutine completed (for immediate-return coroutines)
runtime_invariants.description: After 100K immediate-return coroutines complete, no active coroutines remain.

runtime_invariants.invariant: TCP disconnect closes fd and removes peer
runtime_invariants.description: When a peer disconnects (EOF), the fd is closed and the peer is removed from the peer list.
After block propagation and sync, all 4 nodes have identical chain height, tip hash, and valid=true.

platform_support.note: macOS CI environment uses bash 3.2 (no declare -A) and BSD grep (no -P). Test scripts must be compatible.
TCC build environment is damaged (stddef.h error). TCC runtime has not been verified. This is a known technical debt, not a blocker for mainline development.
platform_support.planned_fix: Future phase will repair TCC build environment and verify TCC runtime.
